meta.title: Hydra
meta.author: Teo
meta.description: The soundtrack of Hydra by Teo (2020-04-12). Executable music that placed 4th in the executable music competition at Revision Online 2020. 128 BPM, 3:07, 32 tracks, 3119 notes. Instruments: 2 Falcon (FM synth), 6 Slaughter (subtractive synth), 3 Adultery (GM.DLS sampler), 9 Specimen (GSM sampler). Effects: 5 Scissor, 6 Smasher, 5 Chamber. Its Adultery instruments play waves from the Windows GM.DLS bank: they sound as intended only with that bank (GM_DLS=<path to gm.dls>); macOS's own GS bank has other waves. This is an adapted version, not the original recording: the WaveSabre song was read from the running executable's memory (tools/ws-extract, Wine), converted by `synth-convert ws` to the unified synth (instrument kind 64, effects 65-73) and imported with `song import` (lanes cut into 2-, 4- or 8-bar patterns, notes rounded to 960 ticks per beat). Against the bit-exact WaveSabre port it differs by +0.04 dB loudness and at most 0.70 dB in any octave band from 63 Hz to 8 kHz (16 kHz up to 3 dB brighter, a known difference of the unified engine). Track names are derived here from each track's instrument and notes; the executable does not store the authors' names. Teo gave permission (2026-11-09) to publish his music here as adapted versions; the music belongs to him and is removed at his request.
